meta.title: Ticking several items of the same PR gives the same list as one item

steps.note: Enable the required team-filtering configuration for the case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen, the required starting point for a PR-based case.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-1 can be searched and assigned.

args.goal: Search for PR-1, select one of its three line items, open Assign using the person icon next to Upload PRs, record the names in the Search a user list, close it, select the other two PR-1 line items as well, reopen Assign, and verify that the names shown are exactly the same as for the one-item selection; leave the second Search a user list open

steps.note: Perform the item-level selection, assignment dialog interaction, and direct comparison that no dedicated catalog step expresses.
Confirm the second assignment user-search box remains open after the comparison.
